summary: First iteration of Socotra Explorer full-stack test. Backend: 33/33 pytest tests pass (auth, content, favorites, bookings, reviews, notifications, admin, 401/403/404 enforcement). Frontend: mobile web preview loads correctly at 390x844, Arabic RTL rendered, login → discover → tabs (map/index/trips/favorites/account) navigation works, trip detail → book-trip → booking modal → confirm-booking creates a persisted booking (verified in DB), marketplace 2-col grid with product-cards and category chips works, search returns grouped results, logout returns to login screen. Only minor React-Native-Web console warnings observed (shadow* / pointerEvents deprecations) — not blocking.

issues: React-Native-Web console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use 'boxShadow' via a Platform.select or migration.
React-Native-Web console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate deprecated RN style props to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence warnings on web preview.
Optional: also confirm confirm-booking closes the modal and routes back to Account > Bookings automatically (currently DB is updated but modal appears to stay open briefly in web preview).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py excludes MongoDB _id via projection everywhere — good.
Auth via Bearer session_token backed by user_sessions with TTL index on expires_at — clean.
Passwords hashed with bcrypt; verify wrapped in try/except.
Admin seed is idempotent (only inserted if destinations count is 0 AND admin doesn't exist).
All backend routes prefixed with /api and mounted via APIRouter — correct for Kubernetes ingress.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows verified (login, discover rails, tabs, trip detail, booking creation, marketplace grid, search, logout)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed. Test-created data: booking rows tagged with 'TEST' full_name, one 'TEST' review, and one random registered TEST_ user. Existing indexes/TTL ensure no long-term pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL + /api. Regular user visitor@socotra.app / Visit@123 (seeded if missing by conftest via /auth/register). Admin admin@socotra.app / Admin@123. All content pre-seeded on first startup. Interactive Google map is native-only — web preview shows a list fallback which is expected, not a bug.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failing tests or bugs surfaced in this iteration.
